subject: SOC 2 request — per-tenant KMS rotation snapshots & transit validation (Finity Bank)
messages:
From: Tim Baker <tim.baker@finitybank.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: security-requests@finitybank.com
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request — rotation snapshots + transit ciphers for Finity Bank

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. As a follow-up for our SOC 2 bridge audit, Finity needs a compact bundle of artifacts focused on key management for the tenant finity-bank-prod. Specifically we need:

- Per-tenant key rotation timeline for the last 12 months (UTC timestamps) with event types (rotate, roll, emergency-rotation) and the KMS key id mapping to tenant id.
- A rotation_snapshot CSV export (redacted principal identity OK) that includes rotation timestamps, key version, and wrapping KEK id.
- KMS/HSM attestation reference (certificate or STAMP id) confirming HSM vendors and firmware versions used at time of rotation.
- A short plaintext list of TLS cipher suites/profiles used by inference endpoints (for transit validation).
- Sample audit log extracts (3 entries) showing a rotation event and the associated access check (redacted).

Can you confirm you can provide these as downloadable artifacts by EOB Friday (2028-09-15)? We are happy to accept redacted extracts and a short note on redaction approach.

Best,
Tim Baker
Senior InfoSec Manager — Finity Bank
On behalf of Finity Security Team

Attachments: none

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Tim Baker <tim.baker@finitybank.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — rotation snapshots + transit ciphers for Finity Bank

Hi Tim — thanks, we can provide this. High-level plan:

1) Produce a per-tenant rotation CSV that we will redacted-principals (we will hash internal principals with SHA256 and include a salt index).
2) Export three representative audit log lines (redacted) showing the rotation flow: request->authorize->rotate.
3) Attach the most recent HSM attestation reference (vendor-signed timestamped cert) and a short note listing firmware/attestation id.
4) Provide TLS cipher list for the endpoint cluster and a brief note on our mTLS termination options for dedicated/private deployments.

I'm looping in Irene (security engineering) and Laura (privacy/compliance) to run the export and check redaction. Irene — can you produce the rotation_snapshot CSV and sample logs (redact PII but preserve tenant and key ids)? Laura — can you confirm redaction approach meets Finity's needs?

Tim — we aim to deliver the bundle by 2028-09-15 17:00 PDT. If Finity needs a stricter SLA (same-day), let us know and we can prioritize with DRI.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — rotation snapshots + transit ciphers for Finity Bank

Folks — pulling the exports now. Notes on deliverables and approach:

- rotation_snapshot_2028-09-01.csv (attachment) — columns: tenant_id, key_alias, key_id (ARN-like), rotation_timestamp_utc, key_version, wrapping_kek_id, rotation_type, operator_hash. Operator_hash = SHA256(operator_email + salt_index) to preserve auditability while redacting identity.
- kms_access_matrix_redacted.pdf (attachment) — role->key access mapping with tenant scoping, last_updated. Sensitive principals removed and replaced with role handles.
- transit_tls_cipher_list.txt (attachment) — current cipher suites for hosted and dedicated clusters, plus earliest supported TLS versions.
- sample_logs.txt (inline) — three log lines (redacted) demonstrating the rotation lifecycle; kept original timestamps in UTC and included nonce trace ids.

A couple of clarifications for Finity:
- HSM attestation: our vendor (Thalios HSM) publishes signed attestation tokens; the file we will share is the attestation reference id and the vendor-signed timestamp (we do not include private keys).
- Rotation cadence: tenant finity-bank-prod uses a hybrid cadence (auto-rotate 90d, emergency rotation as-needed). We will include the explicit UTC timestamps for the last 12 rotations.

I will attach the three files to the next outbound. Laura, tagging you to confirm the redaction sample below is acceptable for Finity (we can provide a different hash salt if they want cross-checking).

Irene Choi
Senior Security Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachments: rotation_snapshot_2028-09-01.csv (CSV, 12KB), kms_access_matrix_redacted.pdf (PDF, 48KB), transit_tls_cipher_list.txt (TXT, 1KB)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Tim Baker <tim.baker@finitybank.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, security-requests@finitybank.com
Date: Tue, 20 Sep 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — rotation snapshots + transit ciphers for Finity Bank

Tim — attaching the artifact bundle we agreed on. Quick notes:

- rotation_snapshot_2028-09-01.csv: contains 12 rotation events (UTC), tenant_id column preserved as "finity-bank-prod", key_id values are redacted to ARN-like forms, operator identities replaced with salted SHA256 hashes.
- kms_access_matrix_redacted.pdf: role-level mapping with tenant scoping; we removed internal employee principals and replaced them with role handles.
- transit_tls_cipher_list.txt: lists current cipher suites; we only support TLS 1.2+; for dedicated we support stricter cipher profiles via TLS policies.
- sample log lines (copied below) include the rotation trace id if you need cross-checks.

Sample logs (redacted):
2028-09-01T02:14:33Z [tenant=finity-bank-prod] TRACE rotation_request id=trace-8f3a5 nonce=0x9c... operator=sha256:6b1f... status=accepted
2028-09-01T02:14:34Z [tenant=finity-bank-prod] TRACE authorize_check id=trace-8f3a5 actor=sha256:6b1f... policy=role:key-rotator outcome=allow
2028-09-01T02:14:36Z [tenant=finity-bank-prod] TRACE rotation_complete id=trace-8f3a5 key_version=3 wrapping_kek_id=wrp-7a2 status=success

If you require additional artifacts (signed attestation files from the HSM vendor, or raw logs with different redaction), please open HS-REQ-4492 or reply to this thread. We can also schedule a short live session with our security engineering team to walk through the exports.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference

Attachments: rotation_snapshot_2028-09-01.csv; kms_access_matrix_redacted.pdf; transit_tls_cipher_list.txt
